facts.fact: UNHCR states that as of June 2026, 37,389 Sudanese refugees have been registered in the Central African Republic since April 2023, in collaboration with the National Commission for Refugees (CNR).
facts.system: UNHCR refugee registration with the CNR

facts.fact: UNHCR reports 737 Sudanese refugees were registered individually in the April-June 2026 quarter, and 1,958 new arrivals in Manou were registered while several thousand more were not yet registered.

UNHCR's partner CIAUD logged 535 complaints through the Information and Returns Centre, including 123 on SCOPE card issues and 58 applications for new SCOPE cards, showing WFP SCOPE cards are being issued to refugees.
